subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should autonomous agents be allowed to create provider channels, and what explicit per-provider gates, permissions, and audit behavior must be required?
rationale: Official provider contracts require privileged administration rights, and current OpenClaw support is asymmetric across Discord and Slack; repository policy does not permit automation to choose this authority boundary.

options.title: Provider-gated administration
options.body: Allow channel creation only behind explicit provider-owned opt-in gates, documented scopes or permissions, runtime checks, and focused tests.

options.title: Operator CLI only
options.body: Expose channel creation to human operators but omit it from autonomous agent action discovery.

options.title: External provisioning
options.body: Keep channel creation in provider APIs or external workflow automation rather than OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Provider-gated administration
recommendation.body: Allow channel creation only behind explicit provider-owned opt-in gates, documented scopes or permissions, runtime checks, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior detailed review and recent area history span the exact CLI, Slack discovery, and Discord routing surfaces requiring this decision.
